methodology.paired: Four processes, one recording and one Q8 model per process. Two warmups and ten measurements per mode. Adjacent comparisons alternate order. Second session reverses recording order and starts with Metal. External synchronized resident seconds include request cleanup; dispatch toggle is outside timing. Cached shader and packed weights are reused. Model loading and audio-file reading excluded.
methodology.standalone: Six processes, both recordings per resident model. Two warmups and five measurements per recording. Second session reverses variant and recording order. Same binary within this study, distinct from the later paired binary.
methodology.profiling: Debug, synchronized diagnostics. Stage barriers alter overlap and add overhead; layer stage sums cannot be added to unbarriered body latency. Sequential profiling runs do not isolate gains in unchanged stages.
methodology.operator: Python MLX 0.32.4, production shader, captured native Q8 routes; thirty measurements per mode with alternating order. Sorted input route preparation excluded; projections, activation, inverse scatter and mixing included.
methodology.accuracy: Exact token parity against previously frozen BF16+DFlash output on two English fixtures; not broad recognition accuracy qualification. Q8 plus dynamic-int8 encoder remains unqualified and was disabled.
methodology.gate: User deferred the full repository gate. Release build, scoped strict lint, 35 focused tests and two real-checkpoint diagnostic profile tests passed.
